body:
Answer: For some overseas employment paths from Pakistan, licensed Overseas Employment Promoter (OEP) processes apply. SK Immigration references partner arrangements such as licence NO/1061 where those rules are relevant — especially around protector and lawful deployment steps. This is not a study-visa licence and not a visa guarantee.

When OEP rules matter

Study and most visit files are different. Employment deployment to certain destinations can require protector / OEP pathways. Ask us which steps apply to your contract.

What to ask any consultant

  • Which licence covers my employment case?
  • Which fees are SK service vs government?
  • What medicals and protector steps are mandatory?

Evidence standard before you spend

For anything related to partner, licence, 1061, keep proofs that a third party can verify: offers on letterhead, bank PDFs with history, attestation receipts, and language results that match the program. Screenshots without context are not a file. If a seller asks you to hide a refusal, change the topic — that is not how SK Immigration works.

  • Offer/contract names match the passport spelling
  • Language rule is printed (IELTS score, MOI, German level, etc.)
  • Funds story matches 3–6 months of statements where missions care about history
  • Attestation order is destination-correct (Apostille vs MOFA paths are not toys)
  • Official mission or university pages were opened the same week you pay

Mistakes we see on “oep partner licence 1061” files

  • Treating “oep partner licence 1061” as a slogan instead of a document checklist
  • Transferring deposits before CUIN and written fee scope are confirmed
  • Copy-pasting another student’s SOP or bank story
  • Hiring anyone who sells a guaranteed visa outcome
